pages.text: A $(bold)focus$() is a part of a diagram that can hold an item or block. $(bold)Item foci$() can be formed by using any item on a chalk mark, which will place the item into the focus. Using chalk on a chalk mark creates an empty item focus that will accept items thrown into it.

$(bold)Block foci$() are any spaces without chalk that are entirely enclosed by chalk (on the same Y-level as the rest of the diagram). A block placed in such a space, or a mob that enters it, is in the block focus.
